severity_rule_registry.description: Context alone cannot create severity when no technical consequence is demonstrated.
A confirmed consequence with explicit criticality and broad reach is critical if realized.
A confirmed consequence with explicit criticality is high even when reach is narrow.
A confirmed consequence with combined consumer and contextual reach is high if realized.
A confirmed consequence without elevated or explicit criticality is moderate if realized.
An unresolved or potential consequence connected to explicit criticality has high severity if it materializes.
An unresolved or potential consequence with elevated, broad context has high severity if it materializes.
Elevated but narrow unresolved or potential consequence is moderate if realized.
Broad reach without explicit or elevated criticality supports moderate severity if realized.
Standard narrow context supports low severity if an unresolved or potential consequence materializes.
Narrow reach with unknown criticality cannot justify realized severity.
